nuggets.text: Use `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\AsCollection` in the `$casts` array for Laravel 8.28 or higher to automatically convert the 'meta' attribute to a collection.
For Laravel 7.x or lower, either create a custom cast or use 'array' cast for the 'meta' attribute.
Direct assignment of the collection works with `AsCollection::class` because Laravel handles the conversion automatically.
